keys.key: src/seeds/contacts.seed.ts:66-70 · seedContacts · the idempotency check uses deletedAt: { $exists: false }, which misses contacts that carry an explicit deletedAt: null (imported ones), so a re-run creates duplicates
src/seeds/pro-microsites.seed.ts:63-89 · seedProMicrosites · the slug-taken skip is gone, so a slug held by another account makes create() throw a duplicate-key error and aborts the whole seed run
src/modules/contacts/contacts.repo.ts:50 · listPaginated · a whitespace-only search passes the truthiness check, the word list filters to empty, and an empty $and makes MongoDB reject the query

src/seeds/journey-invitations.seed.ts:87 · seedJourneyInvitations · journeys are listed across all owners (first 100) instead of the consumer's, so the invitation can attach to another owner's journey with the same template key

findings.effect: The journey lookup ignores the owner and searches only the first 100 journeys platform-wide. It can miss home-seller-v1 and skip the invitation without an error, or select another consumer's journey with that template.
findings.reason: It identifies the unscoped journey lookup and wrong-owner selection in the correct file within one line of S4.

findings.effect: The sender's consumer profile is looked up but only used to skip the invitation when missing. This makes the professional invitation depend on Ricardo also having an unrelated consumer profile.
findings.reason: Despite the incorrect line number, the code does unnecessarily skip professional invitations when the sender lacks an otherwise unused consumer profile.

findings.effect: An unused consumer-profile check skips the invitation with only a warning if Ricardo has no consumer profile, even though the invitation is sent by the professional actor. This causes the pending-invitations eval to fail with no clear cause.
findings.reason: The unused consumer-profile guard unnecessarily blocks professional invitations, but this does not describe S4's wrong-owner journey selection.

findings.effect: The journey is picked by template key from only the first page of 100 journeys. If another home-seller-v1 journey is seeded or the list exceeds 100 journeys, the invitation will silently go to the wrong journey or be skipped.
findings.reason: The journey-selection defect is real, but line 415 is outside S4's ±10-line window and the finding does not name seedJourneyInvitations.
